meta.name: Chris McKane
meta.description: Personal brand site: homepage, about page and blog. All copy is Lorem ipsum placeholder text to be replaced in the admin.
meta.author: Chris McKane

blockTypes.label: Hero (homepage introduction)
blockTypes.description: The opening of the homepage: the main H1 headline, a short introduction, the availability status line, the primary button and the live performance badge.

fields.label: Headline (the page's H1: include your name and role)
Show the availability status line (wording comes from Site options)
Show the primary button (label and link come from Site options and follow the availability mode)
Secondary link: link (starts with /, https://, mailto: or #)
Show the live performance badge (LCP, CLS, page weight, CO2e)
Performance badge methodology link: link (starts with /, https://, mailto: or #)

blockTypes.label: Page header
blockTypes.description: A simple page opening for any page that is not the homepage or About page: the H1 headline and an optional lead paragraph.

blockTypes.label: About intro
blockTypes.description: A short introduction to Chris with an optional photo and a link to the full About page.

fields.label: Photo (alt text is required: images without it are not shown)
Link: link (starts with /, https://, mailto: or #)

blockTypes.label: Approach (organic growth focus)
blockTypes.description: Explains the digital marketing approach as a heading, an introduction and a list of principles. Each principle has a title (H3) and a description.

blockTypes.label: Route links
blockTypes.description: Signposts to the main destinations (for example Blog and About). Optionally ends with the primary call to action from Site options, which follows the availability mode.

fields.label: Add the primary call to action from Site options as the final route

blockTypes.label: Latest posts
blockTypes.description: Lists the most recent blog posts automatically, with a link to the full blog.

fields.label: Link to all posts: link (starts with /, https://, mailto: or #)

blockTypes.label: Contact call to action
blockTypes.description: The closing contact section. Its heading, text and button come from Site options and change with the availability mode, so there is nothing to keep in sync here.

fields.label: Show the contact email address as a link
Section ID (lowercase, used for links such as /#contact)

blockTypes.label: Profile (About page introduction)
blockTypes.description: The opening of the About page: the H1 headline, a lead paragraph, a portrait photo and the biography. Also switches on Person structured data for the page.

fields.label: Portrait photo (alt text is required: images without it are not shown)

blockTypes.label: Experience
blockTypes.description: A list of roles: role title (H3), organisation, period and a short summary.

blockTypes.label: Credentials
blockTypes.description: A list of qualifications, certifications or memberships: name, issuer and year.

blockTypes.label: Text section
blockTypes.description: A general-purpose section of rich text with an optional H2 heading. Use H3 for sub-headings inside the body.

collections.label: Pages
collections.description: Standalone pages built from reorderable sections (blocks). The page with the slug “home” is the homepage and the page with the slug “blog” is the introduction shown above the list of posts at /blog. Every other page is served at /its-slug, for example /about.

fields.label: Title (used in the admin, the browser tab and search results; the visible H1 comes from the first Hero or Profile section)

collections.label: Posts
collections.description: Blog posts, served at /blog/their-slug. Reading time is calculated automatically. The author is set with the Byline panel and the category with the Categories panel.

fields.label: Excerpt (one or two sentences: shown in lists and used as the default meta description)
Featured image (optional; alt text is required: images without it are not shown)
Body (use Heading 2 and Heading 3 only; the title is the only H1)
Last updated (optional: set this when you make a substantial update; shown to readers and search engines)

collections.label: Site options
collections.description: One entry that controls site-wide behaviour: the availability mode (freelance or employed), the primary call to action for each mode, contact wording, contact email and social profiles. Edit the single “Global site options” entry; do not add more.

fields.label: Availability mode (freelance = open for freelance work; employed = blog and thought leadership)
Your name (used in the author box and structured data)
Your job title or role (used in structured data)
Status line when in freelance mode
Status line when in employed mode
Primary button text when in freelance mode
Primary button link when in freelance mode (starts with /, https://, mailto: or #)
Primary button text when in employed mode
Primary button link when in employed mode (starts with /, https://, mailto: or #)
Contact section heading when in freelance mode
Contact section text when in freelance mode
Contact section heading when in employed mode
Contact section text when in employed mode
Social profiles (shown in the footer and contact section, and listed in structured data)
Footer note (optional short line of text)
